items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We all played it. We were all doing record dates that were trying to copy Elvis Presley

ctx.x: As a jazz musician through the years, what was your take on what was happening in the real popular field. When Elvis came on the scene and all that, today’s jazz musician looks at the things, you know the rap is happening and Madonna and that kind of thing. Back then did you have an interest in that kind of music that was coming along, I mean —
We all played it. We were all doing record dates that were trying to copy Elvis Presley and all the other, well I don’t know is Elvis Presley rock ‘n roll? I guess.
He was for a while. And Chuck Berry and those guys.
